summary: Dependency-confusion beacon POSTs host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP on install and require
details: Package publishes under the @grabcad scope and self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim' whose exports are a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property. The package.json postinstall runs `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js invokes the same `fire()` routine on require. beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON body containing os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The shape — public registration of an internal-looking scoped name, inert functionality, and automatic callback on install and import carrying host and build-path identifiers to an external IP — matches the dependency-confusion reconnaissance pattern against a private @grabcad namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
